summary: The rounding failures point to Floor and Ceil using the signed unit when adjusting a truncated result. The INT64_MIN boundary failure also depends on how division, remainder, and Duration arithmetic behave at the representable limit; the supplied excerpts do not include enough of those paths to specify a concrete repair safely.
hypotheses: Floor and Ceil adjust with the signed unit, so a negative unit can move the rounded result in the wrong direction.
With a negative three-second unit at INT64_MIN, the rounding adjustment fails to saturate the mathematically out-of-range floor to negative infinity.
